question: Badminton player ______ won the All England Open men's single title in March 2021.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lee Zii Jia.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Malaysia's Lee Zii Jia__ has won the All England Badminton Championships men's title.
 
• He defeated Axelsen 30-29, 20-22, 21-9 in the summit clash.
 
• Japan's Nozomi Okuhara won the women's title as she defeated Pornpawee Chochuwong 21-12, 21-16 in the finals.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Viktor Axelsen** is a Danish badminton player.

 
 
• He is the **2017 World champion** and the **2020 Olympic champion**.
 
 
 
• **Kento Momota** is a Japanese badminton player.
 
• **Lee Chong Wei** is a triple silver medalist at the Olympic Games, and the sixth Malaysian to win an Olympic medal.
